author: Logan Fuller
name: Decent Sync
description: Sends everything this machine records to a Decent Sync server: shots, steam records, workflow changes, machine state, the library, settings and paired devices. Shares the library's beans with the other machines at its location. Requires Decaid v0.8.7 or newer.

ServerUrl.label: Server URL
ServerUrl.description: The Decent Sync server's address, shown with the token when the machine entry was created, such as https://sync.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:3000.

Token.label: Token
Token.description: This machine's token, shown once when its machine entry was created on the server.

PollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
PollSeconds.description: How often to check the machine, library, settings and paired devices for changes. At least 5.
